name: Waves of Sickness
body:
School necromancy; Level antipaladin 3, cleric/oracle 4, inquisitor 4, lathspell 3, witch 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range 30 ft
Effect cone
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Fortitude partial (harmless); Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You create a burst of horrid stench in front of you causing the creatures within eyes to water and insides to wretch. Subjects wracked by this stench must make a Fortitude save or be nauseated. On each of their turns they may attempt a new save against this effect as a move action. Success ends the effect but the target is sickened for 1 round.
